title: Statement of applicability
description: One statement per control catalogue: for every control whether it applies and why, how far it is implemented, how it is met and who is responsible – with the evidence Steward already holds. Versions are approved by a second person and exported as a signed file.
whoCanAct: Designers and administrators create a statement and decide its rows; approvers and administrators approve its versions.

empty.title: No statement of applicability yet
empty.text: Create one for a control catalogue: it starts with one undecided row per control.

new.title: New statement of applicability
new.intro: One statement per control catalogue. It starts with one row per control, none decided yet.

table.label: Rows of the statement of applicability for {{catalogue}}

counts.attentionHint: {{noEvidence}} without evidence · {{reviewDue}} not reviewed for a year

hints.justification: Needed either way: why the control applies, or why it does not.
hints.owner: A user or team. The owner changes the status, how it is met and the last review.
hints.scopeName: For example the organisation or the part of it the statement covers.
hints.scopeServices: The services whose responsibility matrix makes the suggestions. None: every service.
hints.fourEyes: Whoever submitted a version does not approve it. The assurance policy may require this for every statement.

suggestion.label: From the responsibility matrix
suggestion.none: No responsibility area names this control: no suggestion from the matrix.

entry.ownerHint: You own this row: you change its status, how it is met and the last review.
entry.linksInvalid: Every link needs a title and an http(s) address.
entry.noLinks: No external links, for example a scanner's report or a supplier's trust centre.

settings.title: Settings of the statement
settings.fourEyesPolicy: The assurance policy requires a second person for every statement.
settings.areaDefault: The built-in identifiers of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A apply.
settings.areaOwn: These controls apply instead of the built-in ones.

versions.title: Versions
versions.none: No version yet. Submit the statement once every row is decided.
versions.submitHint: Freezes the rows, the control texts, the evidence and the suggestions into a version.

blocked.undecided: Decide every row first: applies or not, why, and a status for every applicable control.

versions.waiting: Version {{number}} waits for approval – submitted by {{user}} on {{date}}.
versions.fourEyesOn: A second person approves each version.
versions.fourEyesOff: The submitter may approve a version.
versions.verifyHint: Check a signed file offline with: steward evidence verify <file.zip> --fingerprint <key fingerprint>.

decision.ownSubmission: You submitted this version: a second person approves it.

matrix.intro: Who does what for this service. A supplier's SLA, contractual RTO and RPO and its certificates come from the supplier record. The statement of applicability suggests its responsible party from these rows.
matrix.contractHint: Its SLA and contractual RTO and RPO are shown with the area.
matrix.centralName: Name of the central IT or group
matrix.dutyHint: The duty of this service that tests the recovery. Steward does not create it.
matrix.noDuties: The service has no duty yet.
